sentences.zh: 我经常在女儿们一起参加的各种活动上见到奥斯卡。

sentences.en: And I pretended like I didn't know he was on the paper.
sentences.zh: 我还假装不知道他演了这部剧。

sentences.en: He had no idea you knew.
Me and Brian and him talked about doing a fan convention together.
sentences.zh: 我和布라이언还跟他聊过一起办一个粉丝见面会的事。
因为我们保密工作做得滴水不漏。
我们保密工作做得滴水不漏。
我们保密工作做得滴水不漏。

sentences.en: And I'm like so curious to ask Kate.
Like Kate, your longtime partner knew about this, was taking pictures on the set.
sentences.zh: 比如凯特，你长期以来的搭档都知道这件事，还在片场拍了照。

sentences.en: I need a follow-up question with Kate now.
sentences.zh: 我现在得追问凯特一个问题了。
我们和埃莉一起吃过饭。

sentences.en: That's how tight this community is.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们这个群体有多团结严密。

sentences.en: Well, I guess except for the one person who told us about Oscar.
sentences.zh: 不过我猜，除了那个向我们透露奥斯卡消息的人之外。

sentences.en: Well, everyone who knew was very protective of it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所有知道的人都极力保守秘密。

sentences.en: And then ultimately, you know, a reporter found out.
sentences.zh: 然后最终，你知道的，记者发现了。

sentences.en: I am not surprised, though, because it's such a huge secret to keep for so long.
sentences.zh: 不过我一点也不意外，因为保守这么大的秘密这么久太不容易了。

sentences.en: And then they're filming at Universal Studios.
sentences.zh: 而且他们当时还在环球影城拍摄。

sentences.en: But there's like tour buses of people that go through there.
sentences.zh: 但那里有成群的观光巴士穿梭而过。

sentences.en: I mean, there's so many people who could have seen Oscar at Universal Studios.
sentences.zh: 我是说，有那么多人在环球影城可能会看到奥斯卡。

sentences.en: Why don't we take a break?
sentences.zh: 我们为什么不休息一下？

sentences.en: And then when we come back, we are going to talk all about the paper.
sentences.zh: 等我们回来后，我们要好好聊聊报纸的事。
嘿，我是杰西卡·圣克莱尔。

sentences.en: And we are two friends trying to survive the chaos and celebrate the joy that life throws our way.
sentences.zh: 我们是两个试图在生活抛给我们的混乱中生存、并庆祝快乐的朋友。

sentences.en: And we do it every week on our podcast, The Deep Dive.
sentences.zh: 我们每周都会在我们的播客《The Deep Dive》中这样做。

sentences.en: Sometimes we dig into the deep stuff, like how I communicate with my dead best friend.
sentences.zh: 有时我们会深入探讨深奥的事情，比如我如何与我死去的挚友交流。

sentences.en: And sometimes we give bad advice based off a TikTok I saw.
sentences.zh: 有时我们会根据我在 TikTok 上看到的内容给出糟糕的建议。

sentences.en: And we're not going to apologize for that.
Listen to The Deep Dive wherever you get your podcasts from Lemonada Media.
sentences.zh: 在 Lemonada Media 旗下的任意播客平台收听《The Deep Dive》。

sentences.zh: 请注意，WDNC 的所有新老会员。

sentences.zh: 我是梅兰妮·桑德斯，这里是《我们不在乎俱乐部》播客。

sentences.en: We got to midlife and realized we just simply do not care much anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们到了中年，发现自己真的没那么多心思去在乎了。

sentences.en: Now we got to help each other make sense of hot flashes, itchy ears, chin hair, trifling families, brain fog, and bat wings.
sentences.zh: 现在我们要互相帮助，去理清潮热、耳朵发痒、下巴毛发、不靠谱的家人、脑雾以及拜拜肉。

sentences.en: We are not alone, and we will be heard.
sentences.zh: 我们并不孤单，我们的声音会被听见。
所以快来加入 WDNC 吧。

sentences.zh: 在各大播客平台关注并收听由梅兰妮·桑德斯主持的《我们不在乎俱乐部》播客。

sentences.en: And the paper opens with words on a screen.
sentences.zh: 然后屏幕上出现了一行字，为节目拉开序幕。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a title card, and there's a message.
sentences.zh: 对，那是一个片名字幕，上面有一条信息。

sentences.en: In 2005, a documentary crew started filming at a paper company in Scranton, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 2005年，一个纪录片摄制组开始在宾夕法尼亚州斯克兰顿的一家造纸公司进行拍摄。

sentences.en: They followed the workers in an average office dealing with new rules of workplace behavior and the ups and downs of their personal lives.
sentences.zh: 他们记录了一家普通办公室里的员工，他们应对着职场行为的新规则以及个人生活的起起落落。

sentences.en: And the first thing the documentary crew, who's been gone for 20 years, shows us is the Scranton Business Park.
sentences.zh: 而这支离开20年的纪录片摄制组向我们展示的第一件事，就是斯克兰顿商业园。

sentences.en: There are four business signs listed.
sentences.zh: 上面列出了四个商业招牌。

sentences.en: A little bit of a foreshadowing here.
sentences.zh: 这里有点像是某种伏笔。

sentences.en: The businesses listed are Vance Refrigeration,
sentences.zh: 列出的企业有万斯冷藏公司，

sentences.en: One and Done Laser Eye Surgery and Tattoo Removal,
sentences.zh: 一击即中激光视力矫正与纹身清除中心，

sentences.en: And now the camera crew starts to push into those doors that we know, those glass doors.
sentences.zh: 现在摄像机开始推向那些我们熟悉的门，那些玻璃门。

sentences.en: One background catch here, as we scan the parking lot,
sentences.zh: 这里有一个背景细节，当我们扫视停车场时，

sentences.en: everything looks the same, except there are now electric car chargers.
sentences.zh: 一切看起来都一样，除了现在有了电动汽车充电桩。
我甚至都没注意到那个。

sentences.en: Yeah, we are going to go inside, and guess where we start?
sentences.zh: 对，我们要进去了，猜猜我们从哪里开始？

sentences.en: This was such a surprise, and I loved it so much.
sentences.zh: 这真是个巨大的惊喜，我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: We're at Vance Refrigeration, and we are warmly greeted by Bob Vance.
sentences.zh: 我们在万斯冷藏公司，鲍勃·万斯热情地迎了上来。

sentences.en: Bobby Ray does such a great job.
sentences.zh: 鲍比·雷做得真是太棒了。

sentences.en: Bob Vance is going to have a talking head.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃·万斯要有一个访谈镜头了。

sentences.en: He says, hey, Dundra Mifflin's been gone for a while.
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，登德拉·米夫林已经倒闭好一阵子了。

sentences.en: Phyllis and Stanley keep in touch.
sentences.zh: 菲利丝和斯坦利一直有联系。

sentences.en: They've both got the same kind of dog, a schnoodle.
sentences.zh: 他们俩养了同一种狗，雪纳瑞。

sentences.en: He says, you know, the one-and-done guys are less drama, and you're kind of like, who are
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道的，那些干一票就走的人事儿比较少，然后你就会想，
对啊，什么是干一票就走？

sentences.en: Well, we go down the hall to where the Dundra Mifflin offices were.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们走到大厅那边，也就是以前登德拉·米夫林办公室的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah, we go past the elevator.
And first of all, there's no carpeting.

sentences.zh: 看起来像是金属的，亮闪闪的。

sentences.en: It has like LED lights on it.

sentences.zh: 非常现代，看起来极其时髦。

sentences.en: And yeah, it's a laser eye company and laser tattoo removal.
sentences.zh: 而且是一家激光眼科公司和激光洗纹身店。

sentences.en: So the documentary crew clocks this, and then they go back to talk to Bob.
sentences.zh: 所以纪录片摄制组注意到了这一点，然后他们回去找鲍勃谈话。

sentences.en: He's going to get on his computer, and he's going to explain that Dundra Mifflin was purchased
sentences.zh: 他打开电脑，准备解释说登德拉·米夫林是在2019年

sentences.en: in 2019 by a company called Enervate in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 被俄亥俄州一家名叫Enervate的公司收购的。

sentences.en: They asked if Phyllis wanted to leave and move to Toledo, go with the company.
sentences.zh: 他们问菲利丝愿不愿意离职搬去托莱多，跟着公司走。

sentences.en: And Phyllis was like, yeah, right.
sentences.zh: 菲利丝的反应是，少来这一套。
她大概是觉得，离开斯克兰顿？
我有两个背景彩蛋要分享。

sentences.en: For my folks that love a background catch, Bob Vance has a Post-it note on his computer.
sentences.zh: 对于喜欢找背景彩蛋的朋友们，鲍勃·万斯的电脑上贴着一张便利贴。

sentences.en: It's on the top left corner.
And it says in handwriting, 10% discount only on fridges, not labor.
sentences.zh: 上面手写着：10%折扣仅限冰箱，不含人工费。

sentences.en: So you're not going to get a discount on labor.
sentences.zh: 所以人工费是没有任何折扣的。

sentences.en: Also, the Chamber of Commerce website is on the screen.
sentences.zh: 另外，屏幕上打开的是商会网站。

sentences.en: If you go to it, because I did, it is not an active website.
sentences.zh: 如果你去访问它，因为我去过了，它并不是一个有效的网站。

sentences.en: They didn't set up fakie website.
If Dundra Mifflin was sold in 2019, that means it was sold before the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 如果登德拉·米夫林是在2019年被收购的，那就意味着它在疫情爆发前就被卖掉了。

sentences.en: So Dwight never had to deal with, like, COVID rules.
sentences.zh: 所以德怀特根本不用去应付什么新冠防疫规定。

sentences.en: Does Dwight still own the Scranton Park, though?
sentences.zh: 不过德怀特现在还拥有斯克兰顿商业园吗？

sentences.en: Oh, does he still own the building?
sentences.zh: 哦，他还在那栋大楼里有产权吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, because he bought the whole building.
sentences.zh: 对，因为他买下了整栋楼。

sentences.en: We don't know the answer to that right now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在还不知道答案。

sentences.en: Well, I just loved that the show opens with a familiar face.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我特别喜欢节目一开场就是一个熟悉的面孔。

sentences.en: I love hearing that Stanley and Phyllis both have schnoodles.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴听到斯坦利和菲利丝都养了雪纳多犬。

sentences.en: You know, I was just sort of on the edge of my seat when I saw Bobby.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我看到鲍比的时候简直激动得坐立难安。

sentences.en: We did not know he was part of the show.
sentences.zh: 我们之前根本不知道他也参演了。

sentences.en: We knew about Oscar, but I did not know about Bobby.
sentences.zh: 我们知道奥斯卡会来，但不知道鲍比也会来。

sentences.en: Also, did you have to Google schnoodles?
sentences.zh: 另外，你得去谷歌一下什么是雪纳多犬吗？

sentences.en: No, I just assumed they were like a schnauzer and a poodle.
sentences.zh: 没有，我只是猜它们就像雪纳瑞和贵宾犬的结合。

sentences.en: I mean, it's like a Labradoodle is like a Labrador and a poodle.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就像拉布拉多贵宾犬是拉布拉多和贵宾犬结合一样。

sentences.en: I guess it didn't click for me what a schnoodle was.
sentences.zh: 我当时好像没反应过来雪纳多犬是什么意思。

sentences.en: I didn't know you could mix a schnauzer and a poodle.
sentences.zh: 我不知道雪纳瑞和贵宾犬还能串种。

sentences.en: I don't know, and I don't want to think about it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，我也不想去细想。

sentences.en: But back to Bobby Ray for a second.
sentences.zh: 不过我们回过头来再聊一下鲍比·雷。

sentences.en: So, you guys, we did an AT&T commercial.
sentences.zh: 各位，我们拍了个AT&T的广告。

sentences.en: It's out in the world now.
You will have seen some of it.
sentences.zh: 你们应该已经看到一部分了。

sentences.en: They've really gotten almost the entire caSt.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎把整个演员阵容都请到了。

sentences.en: Well, we were on set one day, and we were just chatting.
sentences.zh: 有一天我们在片场，当时正闲聊着。

sentences.en: I was asking him how his life is.
sentences.zh: 我问他最近过得怎么样。

sentences.en: He has a very peaceful existence on this nice big property in West Virginia,
sentences.zh: 他在西弗吉尼亚州有一处宽敞舒适的房产，过着非常平静的生活，
然后我们交换了电话号码。

sentences.en: And when I watched this, I was like, oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 当我看到这个的时候，我心想，天哪。

sentences.en: Bobby Ray was in it and didn't even tell me.
sentences.zh: 鲍比·雷参演了居然都没告诉我。

sentences.en: So, I texted him, and I was like,
can you please share with us what it was like to be on the paper?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我们分享一下登上报纸是什么感觉吗？

sentences.en: And he sent us in this lovely audio clip.
sentences.zh: 然后他给我们发来了这段可爱的音频剪辑。

sentences.en: Hello to the office ladies, Angela and Jenna, and your loyal listeners.
sentences.zh: 向《Office Ladies》的两位女士，安吉拉和珍娜，以及所有忠实听众问好。

sentences.en: This is Bobby Ray Schaefer, a.k.a.
sentences.zh: 我是鲍比·雷·谢弗，也就是

sentences.en: I'm pleased to join you today to talk about my experience filming the new TV show,
sentences.zh: 很高兴今天能来和大家聊聊我拍摄新电视剧的经历，

sentences.en: There I was, in my house, on the hill, in the woods, in West Virginia, minding my own business.
sentences.zh: 当时我在西弗吉尼亚州树林里山上的房子里，过着我自己的平静生活。

sentences.en: And I was working on my autobiography, which I'm sure the listeners will delight in the title,
sentences.zh: 我当时正在写自传，我相信听众们一定会喜欢这本书的名字，

sentences.en: which is, What Line of Work Are You In, Bob?
sentences.zh: 叫做《鲍勃，你是做什么工作的？》。

sentences.en: Of course, it's about all the jobs that I had in my career, including the most famous and loved of them all,
sentences.zh: 当然，这本书记录了我职业生涯中所有的工作，包括其中最著名、最受喜爱的，

sentences.en: the office, thanks to the greatest fans ever.
sentences.zh: 《办公室》，感谢史上最棒的粉丝们。

sentences.en: So, I receive an email in my inbox one morning, and I open it up, and it's from Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 有一天早上，我的收件箱里收到了一封邮件，我打开一看，是好莱坞发来的。

sentences.en: Would I be available for a new Greg Daniels project?
sentences.zh: 问我有没有空参与格雷格·丹尼尔斯的新项目？

sentences.en: Well, there's only one answer to that, and it is, of course, yes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这个问题只有一个答案，那就是，当然有。

sentences.en: So, I send back my availability is total.
sentences.zh: 于是我回复说我完全有时间。

sentences.en: And then I had to wait for a while.
sentences.zh: 然后我就得等上一阵子。

sentences.en: You know how that goes, ladies.
And at the time, I had thought when I left L.A.
sentences.zh: 当时我想过，自我离开洛杉矶

sentences.en: after 40 years of grinding, that I would never go back.
sentences.zh: 打拼了40年之后，我绝不会再回去了。

sentences.en: But, of course, as I told the producer who contacted me, I've never said no to Greg Daniels, and I'm not going to start now.
sentences.zh: 但正如我告诉联系我的制片人那样，我从来没有拒绝过格雷格·丹尼尔斯，这次也不会破例。

sentences.en: So, after about a month of, is it going to happen, is it not going to happen?
sentences.zh: 所以，经过大约一个月“到底能不能成”的纠结，

sentences.en: And I found myself right back in the old mindset of, it is, it isn't, it is, it isn't.
sentences.zh: 我又回到了那种“能成、不成、能成、不成”的旧思维模式中。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's torture for an actor.
sentences.zh: 你们知道的，这对演员来说简直是折磨。

sentences.en: But after not having to go through it for a while, it was kind of fun to be back in it, to tell you the truth.
sentences.zh: 但有一段时间不用经历这些之后，说实话，重新经历这种感觉还挺有意思的。
各项事宜都安排妥当了。

sentences.en: And I found myself on a big old jet plane to the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 我坐上了一架飞往西海岸的大型老式喷气客机。

sentences.en: I went to the set the next morning, and I'd say that was the biggest difference in the office and the paper, is that being on the universal lot.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上我去了片场，要说《办公室》和《The Paper》最大的不同，那就是它在环球影城外景地上。

sentences.en: When I would walk out of my trailer, you know, the tour carts would come rolling by, and all the people were waving and staring and yelling.
sentences.zh: 当我走出房车时，游览观光车刚好开过，所有人都在挥手、盯着看、大喊大叫。

sentences.en: And that was a new dimension to filming.
sentences.zh: 这给拍摄带来了一种全新的维度。

sentences.en: But anyway, it was fantastic to be back in the Vance Refrigeration office.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，能回到范斯制冷的办公室真是太棒了。

sentences.en: As you know, details are key on the office, and they are, too, on the paper, because it was a perfect replica right down to a secretary and the whole office.
sentences.zh: 如你们所知，细节在《办公室》里至关重要，《The Paper》里也是如此，因为这里简直是个完美的复刻，连秘书和整个办公室都一模一样。

sentences.en: You know, I really knew then what deja vu felt like.
sentences.zh: 那一刻我真的懂得了什么是似曾相识的感觉。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, I'd been there before.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我以前去过那里。

sentences.en: But it was delightful to see all the, there were many of the crew members.
sentences.zh: 但很高兴能见到所有……现场有许多老工作组人员。

sentences.en: And the key guy, of course, other than Mr. Daniels, was Sergio, our caterer.
sentences.zh: 核心人物当然除了丹尼尔斯先生外，还有我们的餐饮主管塞尔吉奥。

sentences.en: And he was there, and it was a delight to see him.
sentences.zh: 他也来了，见到他真是太高兴了。

sentences.en: And Veda, the script supervisor, and Dave Rogers, the editor.
sentences.zh: 还有剧本总监维达，以及剪辑师戴夫·罗杰斯。

sentences.en: And so it was like old home week.
sentences.zh: 所以这感觉就像是老友重逢的欢聚一周。

sentences.en: And it was really just a wonderful feeling to be back involved with those great people, so talented.
sentences.zh: 能重新和这群才华横溢、伟大的人共事，这种感觉真的很美好。

sentences.en: And Greg was directing the pilot.
sentences.zh: 格雷格亲自执导了试播集。

sentences.en: And so I got to spend some quality time with him.
sentences.zh: 所以我得以和他在一块儿度过了一段美好的时光。

sentences.en: And he had written a very smart, funny open.
sentences.zh: 他写了一个非常聪明、有趣的开场。

sentences.en: I hope you'll all enjoy it.
And the main reason I did it, of course, other than, you know, it was Greg, is the historical link with the office.
sentences.zh: 我接拍的主要原因，当然除了因为格雷格之外，就是与《办公室》的历史渊源。

sentences.en: As you know, as many of you know, I've been doing a lot of fan shows.
sentences.zh: 如你们所知，你们很多人都知道，我一直在参加很多粉丝见面会活动。

sentences.en: And I have to say, I'll say it again, we do have the greatest fans in television show history.
sentences.zh: 我必须得说，我再说一遍，我们确实拥有电视史上最棒的粉丝。

sentences.en: And I want to thank you all very much for making us feel so treasured and cherished.
sentences.zh: 我想非常感谢大家让我们感到如此被珍视和宠爱。

sentences.en: It's really, truly a great honor.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一项极大的荣誉。

sentences.en: And it's been a blessing to be able to make people happy with just a photo and a signature.
sentences.zh: 而且仅仅通过一张照片和一个签名就能让人们开心，这真是一种福气。

sentences.en: So, office ladies, you're kicking butt, taking names.
sentences.zh: 所以，各位办公室女郎，你们干得漂亮，大显身手。

sentences.en: I just loved all of that.
sentences.zh: 我刚才真的超喜欢所有这些。

sentences.en: And I texted him thank you so much from the two of us.
sentences.zh: 我给他发了短信，代表我们两个向他表示非常感谢。

sentences.en: And he said, well, Ange, thank you.
And know that I forgive you for spitting on me.
sentences.zh: 还要知道我原谅你朝我吐口水。

sentences.en: And I said, I said, when did I spit on you?
sentences.zh: 我说，我说，我什么时候朝你吐口水了？

sentences.en: I guess I'm a hot mess.
I thought maybe I spit on him on the AT&T commercial.
sentences.zh: 我想也许是在拍AT&T广告时我朝他吐口水了。

sentences.en: And he wrote back and he said, ha-ha, fun run.
I made a remark about the dead cat.
So now I want to go back to fun run deleted scenes and be like, I totally forgot that scene.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我想回去看欢乐跑的删减片段，然后心想，我完全忘了那一幕。

sentences.en: Well, Greg told me that they went back to our old lot and they restored the Scranton Business
sentences.zh: 格雷格告诉我，他们回到了我们以前的外景地，并且为了开场建立镜头

sentences.en: sign park for that opening establishing shot.
sentences.zh: 恢复了斯克兰顿商业园的招牌。

sentences.en: And he said that on that day, some fans were there and they came and took photos.
sentences.zh: 他说那天有些粉丝在那里，他们过来拍了照片。

sentences.en: He was like, they got really lucky because, you know, that sign is not usually there.
sentences.zh: 他当时说，他们真的很幸运，因为你知道，那个招牌通常不在那里。

sentences.en: He said it was just kind of cool to see it there again.
sentences.zh: 他说再次在那里看到它感觉挺酷的。

sentences.en: But like Bobby said, the Vance refrigeration and the Eye Center and the elevator, all of that,
sentences.zh: 但就像鲍比说的，凡斯冷气公司、眼科中心和电梯，所有这些，

sentences.en: they completely rebuilt on a soundstage at the Universal lot.
sentences.zh: 都是他们在环球影城外景地的摄影棚里完全重建的。

sentences.en: Because that's where they shot the paper was on a soundstage at the Universal lot.
sentences.zh: 因为他们拍摄纸业公司的地方就是环球影城的一个摄影棚。

sentences.en: And we went and visited there.
And, you know, we were walking to our cars at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，那天结束时我们正走向汽车。

sentences.en: He walked us out after our visit.
sentences.zh: 我们参观完后他送我们出来。

sentences.en: And one of those buses went by.
sentences.zh: 其中一辆观光车开了过去。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's like an open air bus with a bunch of visitors who are coming to Universal Studios.
sentences.zh: 对，就像那种露天巴士，上面坐着一群来环球影城参观的游客。

sentences.en: You get the tour of the whole back lot.
And there we were standing there.
sentences.zh: 而我们当时就站在那儿。

sentences.en: And Greg literally was like, get down.
sentences.zh: 格雷格简直就像是说，趴下。
像躲在垃圾桶后面一样扑过去。

sentences.en: We literally dove behind a dumpster.
sentences.zh: 我们真的扑到了垃圾桶后面。

sentences.en: Because we did not want people to see us there.
sentences.zh: 因为我们不想让别人看到我们在那儿。

sentences.en: Because there were the rumors that the paper was happening.
sentences.zh: 因为当时有传言说这部剧要开拍了。

sentences.en: But I have to say, hearing now that people took pictures of that Scranton Park sign at our old set.
sentences.zh: 但我得说，现在听说有人拍下了我们旧片场那个斯克兰顿公园的标志。

sentences.en: I bet you have laser one and done.
sentences.zh: 我敢说你们肯定一眼就能看出来。

sentences.en: Well, now that our documentary crew has figured out that Dunder Mifflin was bought by Enervate,
sentences.zh: 好了，既然我们的纪录片摄制组已经发现邓德·米福林被恩维特收购了，

sentences.en: we're going to go to Enervate.
Yes, to the Truth Teller Tower.
And we go upstairs and we're going to see a bunch of workers in these like glass-walled cubicles.
sentences.zh: 我们上楼，会看到一群工人在那种玻璃墙的隔间里。

sentences.en: And one of them is shaving.
He's got an electric shaver and he's reclining, kind of shaving.
sentences.zh: 他拿着一个电动剃须刀，半躺着，一边刮胡子。

sentences.en: He's getting the side eye from the person in the cubicle next to him.
sentences.zh: 旁边隔间的人正斜眼看他。

sentences.en: Shout out to Steven Socks, who played the man shaving his face.
sentences.zh: 向扮演那个刮脸男人的史蒂文·索克斯致敬。

sentences.en: You might recognize that name because we have talked about him and his wife, Lori, for years.
sentences.zh: 你可能对这个名字很熟悉，因为我们谈论他和他的妻子洛瑞已经好几年了。

sentences.en: They were the stand-in team on The Office.
sentences.zh: 他们曾是《办公室》的替身演员组。

sentences.en: They both had cameos on The Office, and I was so tickled to see him on the paper.
sentences.zh: 他们俩都在《办公室》里客串过，看到他出现在这部剧里我太高兴了。

sentences.en: When we visited, we saw both Steven and Lori, and it was so cool, but I had no idea that he had a cameo.
sentences.zh: 我们去探班时，见到了史蒂文和洛瑞，这太酷了，但我根本不知道他有客串。

sentences.en: Neither did I because everybody locked it up.
sentences.zh: 我也不知道，因为大家都保密得严严实实的。

sentences.en: So when we watched this, I texted him about working on the paper.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们看这部剧时，我给他发信息问了关于参演这部剧的事。

sentences.en: I asked him how him and Lori came to work on the paper, what it was like working on the show, what it was like to do this cameo.
sentences.zh: 我问他和洛瑞是如何来参演这部剧的，在片场工作是什么感觉，客串的感觉怎么样。

sentences.en: And he sent us the most lovely message, just like Bobby Ray.
sentences.zh: 他给我们发来了一段非常暖心的信息，就像鲍比·雷一样。

sentences.en: Everyone has just been so wonderful.
Lori and I both got to work on the paper, and the pilot episode was really a thrill.
sentences.zh: 我和洛瑞都有幸参与了这部剧，试播集真的让人非常激动。

sentences.en: I mean, somehow, we were both able to work on The Office for all those years, and we made so many memories.
sentences.zh: 我是说，不知怎么的，我们竟然能在《办公室》工作了那么多年，留下了那么多回忆。

sentences.en: And as soon as we found out about there even being a true Office spinoff, we reached out to Greg Daniels, who is just so kind and just absolutely brilliant.
sentences.zh: 而且一听说真的会有《办公室》的衍生剧，我们就联系了格雷格·丹尼尔斯，他不仅人非常好，而且绝对才华横溢。

sentences.en: And somehow, we got to work on this brand new show.
sentences.zh: 不知怎么的，我们竟然又参与了这部全新的剧集。

sentences.en: Well, one day, I had a break from filming, and I walked over to one of the other stages we were using, and I saw the outside of a set that had just been built.
sentences.zh: 有一天，我拍戏间隙休息，走到我们使用的另一个片场，看到刚刚搭建好的一处布景的外观。

sentences.en: And from the outside, a set just looks like wood and nails and a door here and there.
sentences.zh: 从外面看，片场不过是木头、钉子和几扇门而已。

sentences.en: And it's not until you open the door and step inside that the set is revealed.
sentences.zh: 直到你推开门走进去，布景才会展现出来。

sentences.en: There was no one else, not a single person on the stage, and so I was all alone.
sentences.zh: 当时没有别人，片场里一个人也没有，所以我孤身一人。

sentences.en: And I was curious about what we might shoot the next few days.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇接下来几天我们要拍什么。

sentences.en: You know, it could have been a restaurant or an apartment or whatever.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，可能是一家餐厅、一间公寓什么的。

sentences.en: So I opened one of the doors, and it was the office's elevator lobby.
sentences.zh: 于是我推开其中一扇门，发现那是办公室的电梯大堂。

sentences.en: I had entered that door that was a stairwell door next to Bob Vance's glass door.
sentences.zh: 我走进的那扇门，正是鲍勃·凡斯玻璃门旁边的那个楼梯间门。

sentences.en: And I was instantly taken back to the old Chandler Valley Studios in Van Nuys.
sentences.zh: 我瞬间被带回了位于范奈斯的钱德勒山谷旧片场。

sentences.en: It was shocking and emotional, actually.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当时既震撼又充满情绪。

sentences.en: I walked up to the elevator, and so many memories flooded my brain.
sentences.zh: 我走到电梯前，无数的回忆涌上心头。

sentences.en: And I thought of one of the most vivid memories on the show.
sentences.zh: 我想起了剧中印象最深刻的一个场景。

sentences.en: It was Steve Carell's last day, and specifically, Steve's last scene.
sentences.zh: 那是史蒂夫·卡瑞尔的最后一天，具体来说，是史蒂夫的最后一场戏。

sentences.en: The scene was when Michael says goodbye to the office, and he walks to the elevator and exits the building.
sentences.zh: 这场戏是迈克尔向办公室告别，他走向电梯并离开大楼。

sentences.en: The day before, Greg had asked me to wear a suit, and so he put me in the scene.
sentences.zh: 前一天，格雷格让我穿上一套西装，于是他把我安排进了这场戏。

sentences.en: Me and a mail courier walk out of the elevator.
sentences.zh: 我和一个邮件快递员一起走出了电梯。

sentences.en: As Michael walks in, on Steve's last take, I watched the character, Michael Scott, enter the elevator, and the doors closed.
sentences.zh: 当迈克尔走进来时，在史蒂夫的最后一条镜头中，我看着迈克尔·斯科特这个角色走进电梯，门关上了。

sentences.en: And then after the scene ended, the doors opened, and the actor, Steve Carell, stepped out.
sentences.zh: 场景结束门打开后，演员史蒂夫·卡瑞尔走了出来。

sentences.en: It really was just him and I in the lobby at that point, and I couldn't help myself, and I just gave him a big hug.
sentences.zh: 当时大厅里真的只有我和他两个人，我情不自禁地给了他一个大大的拥抱。

sentences.en: Well, here I was, back in that space, and I had goosebumps.
sentences.zh: 就这样，我回到了那个地方，起了一身鸡皮疙瘩。

sentences.en: I saw Bob Vance's office, and then I walked toward the Dunder Mifflin office, and it was a laser hair removal place.
sentences.zh: 我看到了鲍勃·万斯办公室，然后走向邓德·米弗林办公室，结果那里变成了一家激光脱毛店。

sentences.en: So it was, Dunder Mifflin was gone.
sentences.zh: 所以，邓德·米弗林已经不复存在了。

sentences.en: And what I felt at that moment was just closure.
sentences.zh: 我那一刻感受到的只有释怀。

sentences.en: Life moves on, and art shows us in amazing ways that life has changed.
sentences.zh: 生活在继续，而艺术以惊人的方式向我们展现了生活的变迁。

sentences.en: I got to stand there in that moment, full of gratitude for all that the office meant to me.
sentences.zh: 我在那一刻驻足，对《办公室》对我而言的一切充满了感激。

sentences.en: And then in that same breath, I got to pivot to this brand new show.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我又得以转向这部全新的剧集。

sentences.en: And then, like, the next day, they asked me if I could come in and work with the talented Tim Key in one of the opening scenes of the pilot.
sentences.zh: 然后，就像是第二天，他们问我能不能来和才华横溢的蒂姆·基一起拍试播集的一个开场镜头。

sentences.en: Just an incredible experience that I will never forget.
sentences.zh: 这是一次我永生难忘的不可思议的经历。

sentences.en: Well, I cried the first time I listened to that.
sentences.zh: 我第一次听的时候都哭了。

sentences.en: Because he's right about what art can show us, and I just can't imagine what it was like.
sentences.zh: 因为他说得很对，关于艺术能向我们展现什么，我简直无法想象当时那种感觉是什么样的。

sentences.en: Like, it feels like time travel.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像时间旅行一样。

sentences.en: If I could open a door and be standing in that elevator bay again.
sentences.zh: 如果我也能推开一扇门，重新站在那个电梯间里。

sentences.en: And I didn't know that story, that he had that moment with Steve.
sentences.zh: 我以前不知道这个故事，不知道他和史蒂夫有过那样的一刻。

sentences.en: And then now he is there again all these years later in that same elevator bay.
sentences.zh: 而现在，时隔多年，他又回到了那个相同的电梯间。

sentences.en: And, yeah, I thought Stephen said it all so well.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得史蒂芬把这一切都表达得太好了。

sentences.en: I felt everything that he shared.
sentences.zh: 他分享的每一种感受我都感同身受。

sentences.en: It makes me so excited for this group of people.
sentences.zh: 这让我对这群演员充满期待。

sentences.en: I just hope that this show gets to give them what The Office gave us.
sentences.zh: 我只希望这部剧能带给他们当年《办公室》带给我们的那种体验。

sentences.en: Well, now we are going to cut to a talking head of Ken.
sentences.zh: 那么，现在我们要切入肯的访谈镜头。

sentences.en: Ken is played by Tim Key.
He is the head of strategy for the corporate offices at Enervate.
sentences.zh: 他是Enervate公司总部战略部负责人。

sentences.en: And he's going to explain to us what Enervate does.
sentences.zh: 他将向我们解释Enervate是做什么的。

sentences.en: Enervate sells products made out of paper.
So that might be office supplies.
That might be janitorial paper, which is toilet tissue, toilet seat protectors, and local newspapers.
sentences.zh: 也可能是保洁用纸，也就是卫生纸、马桶垫纸以及当地报纸。

sentences.en: And that is in order of quality.
I loved at the very end when he says in order of quality, he thinks he's being funny.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢最后他说“按质量从高到低排列”的时候，他觉得自己挺搞笑的。

sentences.en: And he has this little smirk look to camera, and it just cracked me up.
sentences.zh: 他对着镜头露出了那种微微的假笑，真的把我逗笑了。

sentences.en: Now he's going to take us on the tour of the offices.
sentences.zh: 现在他要带我们参观办公室了。

sentences.en: He explains that the corporate offices are on the eighth floor.
sentences.zh: 他解释说公司办公室在八楼。

sentences.en: He's going to take us up to the ninth floor.
This reminded me of our pilot where Michael Scott is taking you on a tour of Dunder Mifflin because he starts introducing everybody.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了我们的试播集，迈克尔·斯科特带你参观邓德米弗林，因为他开始介绍每一个人。

sentences.en: So we find out that the ninth floor is home to Softie's toilet paper.
sentences.zh: 所以我们发现九楼是软萌卷纸（Softie's）的所在地。

sentences.en: And when he opens the door, by the way, this is when we get our first glimpse of the set.
sentences.zh: 当他打开门的时候，顺便说一下，我们就是在这个时候第一次看到了片场。

sentences.en: It is this big open space, but there are very few people in it.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的开放空间，但里面的人很少。

sentences.en: Michael Komen told me that this scene was the very first scene they shot of the paper.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·科门告诉我，这场戏是他们拍这部剧的第一场戏。

sentences.en: Well, you know, as Ken walks through, he's greeting his toilet kings and one queen, who I think has a little bit of an Angela Martin vibe.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当肯走过时，他在向他的卷纸之王们以及唯一的女王打招呼，我觉得她有点安吉拉·马丁的风格。

sentences.en: She's got that ponytail pulled back tight.
And I love the throwaway snarky comment Ken said as he walked past her.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢肯走过她身边时顺口说出的那句讽刺的话。

sentences.en: He says, scrunchie, no harm in it because she has her hair in a scrunchie.
sentences.zh: 他说，发圈，没什么大不了的，因为她用发圈扎着头发。

sentences.en: It was just a really funny throwaway line.
sentences.zh: 这只是一句非常有趣的随口台词。

sentences.en: Toilet Queen, is our first writer-performer.
sentences.zh: 卷纸女王，是我们第一位编剧兼演员。

sentences.en: She is a character that we're going to see at Softie's named Kimberly, and she is played by Mo Welch.
sentences.zh: 她是我们在软萌卷纸里会看到的一个角色，名叫金伯利，由莫·韦尔奇饰演。

sentences.en: Ken continues now to show us the rest of the Softie's side of the office.
sentences.zh: 肯现在继续带我们参观办公室里软萌卷纸的另一侧。

sentences.en: There's a lot of old artwork and logos.
sentences.zh: 有很多旧的艺术品和标志。

sentences.en: And then he takes us to a gong that they hit whenever a sale is made.
sentences.zh: 然后他带我们去看一面锣，只要达成一笔销售他们就会敲响它。

sentences.en: I have to imagine that's going to drive everyone crazy if you work there.
sentences.zh: 我不得不想象，如果你在那里工作，那会把每个人都逼疯的。

sentences.en: And this is when he introduces us to what's on the other side of the office, which is the local newspaper, the Toledo Truth Teller.
sentences.zh: 也就是在这个时候，他向我们介绍了办公室另一侧的东西，也就是当地的报纸《托莱多真理报》。

sentences.en: We find out that this entire building—
It used to house the newspaper with a staff of like a thousand.
sentences.zh: 它以前是一家员工大约有一千人的报社所在地。

sentences.en: And now they're just like half of this floor, and there's like seven of them.
sentences.zh: 而现在他们只占了这一层的一半，大概只有七个人。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're going to watch a little black-and-white documentary.
sentences.zh: 对，我们要看一小段黑白纪录片。

sentences.en: That's the year I was born.
Guys, we did have color TV in 1971.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，1971年我们确实有彩色电视。

sentences.en: I think we just needed to differentiate between our current day story and this like documentary.
sentences.zh: 我想我们只是需要区分我们当下的故事和这个类似纪录片的东西。

sentences.en: Anyway, I'm sure that's exactly why they did it, but it did crack me up.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，我确信这正是他们这么做的原因，但真的把我逗乐了。

sentences.en: So we're watching this old documentary, and it's being hosted by John Stack, the publisher
sentences.zh: 所以我们当时在看一部老纪录片，由《托莱多真相报》
的出版商约翰·斯塔克主持。

sentences.en: And we're seeing our same set, but now it is just filled with like wall-to-wall people.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了同样的布景，但现在里面挤满了人，水泄不通。

sentences.en: John Stack is played by Tracy Letts.
sentences.zh: 约翰·斯塔克由特雷西·莱茨饰演。

sentences.en: Oh, your theater nerd heart went into overdrive.
sentences.zh: 哦，你内心的戏剧迷之魂瞬间燃爆了。
你当时就像是在说，安吉拉。

sentences.en: He was multiple Tony Award winner.
He wrote August to Osage County.
He won a Tony for playing George in the revival of Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf.
sentences.zh: 他因在重排版《谁害怕弗吉尼亚·伍尔芙》中饰演乔治而赢得托尼奖。

sentences.en: I went to Chicago to see his play, Superior Donuts, at Steppenwolf, and lady, afterwards,
sentences.zh: 我特意去芝加哥的荒原狼剧团看他的话剧《高级甜甜圈》，天哪，演出结束后，

sentences.en: I got to go out and have drinks with him.
sentences.zh: 我有幸和他一起出去喝了酒。
你当时表现得很淡定吗？
有没有说出什么荒唐的话？

sentences.en: So I asked Michael Komen, I was like, how did you get Tracy Letts on the show?
sentences.zh: 所以我问迈克尔·科门，我说，你是怎么请到特雷西·莱茨来演这个节目的？

sentences.en: And Michael Komen was like, as big of a nerd about him as I was.
